Class MonitorConfigUtils

  • Method Details

    • fromSchedule

      @Nullable public static @Nullable MonitorConfig fromSchedule(@Nullable @Nullable String cron, @Nullable @Nullable String zone, @Nullable @Nullable Long intervalMillis)
      Builds a monitor config from exactly one of a cron or a fixed interval.
      Parameters:
      cron - 6 field cron (seconds first) or macro, null or empty if unset
      zone - cron time zone, ignored for intervals
      intervalMillis - fixed rate, null if unset
      Returns:
      null if the schedule can't be expressed as a Sentry monitor schedule

    • fromSpringScheduled

      @Nullable public static @Nullable MonitorConfig fromSpringScheduled(@Nullable @Nullable String cron, @Nullable @Nullable String zone, @Nullable @Nullable Long fixedRateMillis, @Nullable @Nullable Long fixedDelayMillis, boolean legacyCronParser)
      Builds a monitor config from Spring @Scheduled values with placeholders resolved. Reads the cron and a cron without zone the way Spring does.
      Parameters:
      cron - Spring cron, null or empty if unset
      zone - cron time zone, null or empty for the JVM default zone
      fixedRateMillis - null if unset
      fixedDelayMillis - null if unset; a fixed delay never gets a config
      legacyCronParser - true for Spring before 5.3, which parses crons with CronSequenceGenerator
      Returns:
      null if the schedule can't be expressed as a Sentry monitor schedule

    • parsePeriodMillis

      @Nullable public static @Nullable Long parsePeriodMillis(@Nullable @Nullable String value, @NotNull @NotNull TimeUnit defaultUnit)
      Parses a plain number in defaultUnit or a Spring 6.1 simple duration like 30s. ISO-8601 is not supported.
      Returns:
      milliseconds, or null if unparseable
